description: Find service failures and control the services this instance permits. Inspect status and logs, then start, stop or reload a selected unit. Start with failed or status; changes stay within the configured scope and require the appropriate role.
author: Serg Parf

list.help: Find loaded units, including inactive ones. Optionally select a unit type.

timers.help: Check timers' last and next scheduled runs.

status.help: Inspect the status of one unit.

logs.help: Read recent journal output, capped at 256 KiB. Without a unit, the call still respects this instance's configured unit scope.

args.name: since
args.help: Positive age, 1..99999 followed by m, h or d; text uses since <age>

start.help: Start a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.

restart.help: Stop and start a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.

reload.help: Ask a unit within this instance's configured scope to reload.

stop.help: Stop a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.

enable.help: Enable a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.

disable.help: Disable a unit allowed by this instance's configured scope.

help.help: Find available calls. Use help-config for configuration and help-secret for environment key names.

units.help: Comma-separated exact unit names; omitted allows every host unit

unit.help: Exact fully qualified Linux unit name, for example nginx.service
